'''Jenna Forbes''' is a character in the [[3D Universe]] who appears as a radio guest in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. She is voiced by [[Laura Bykowski]].

== Character history ==
Jenna Forbes is, in [[1992]], a [[Vinewood in GTA III Era|Vinewood]] based actress who is interviewed by [[Lazlow Jones|Lazlow]] on [[Entertaining America]] with trailers of the interview being broadcast during the events of GTA San Andreas. Lazlow asks her if she would like to sleep with him.

== Trivia ==
*She shares her last name with [[Bryan Forbes]], although there is no information to suggest they are related.
